segments.sn42.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati uttaraṃ nāma [uttarakaṃ nāma (sī.)] koliyānaṃ nigamo.
segments.sn42.13:1.2: Atha kho pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.13:2.1: Ye te, bhante, evamāhaṃsu – ‘samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātī’ti, kacci te, bhante, bhagavato vuttavādino, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?
segments.sn42.13:2.3: “Ye te, gāmaṇi, evamāhaṃsu – ‘samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātī’ti, vuttavādino ceva me, te na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti,
segments.sn42.13:2.4: saccaṃyeva kira, bho, mayaṃ tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ na saddahāma –
segments.sn42.13:2.5: ‘samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti, samaṇo khalu bho gotamo māyāvī’ti.
segments.sn42.13:2.6: Yo nu kho, gāmaṇi, evaṃ vadeti – ‘ahaṃ māyaṃ jānāmī’ti, so evaṃ vadeti – ‘ahaṃ māyāvī’ti.
segments.sn42.13:2.7: Tatheva taṃ bhagavā hoti, tatheva taṃ sugata hotī”ti.
segments.sn42.13:2.8: Tena hi, gāmaṇi, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi; yathā te khameyya, tathā taṃ byākareyyāsi –
segments.sn42.13:3.4: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, kimatthiyā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:3.5: “Ye ca, bhante, koliyānaṃ corā te ca paṭisedhetuṃ, yāni ca koliyānaṃ dūteyyāni tāni ca vahātuṃ [tāni ca pahātuṃ (syā. kaṃ.), tāni ca yātuṃ (katthaci), tāni cāvahātuṃ (?)], etadatthiyā, bhante, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā”ti.
segments.sn42.13:3.7: jānāsi tvaṃ koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe sīlavante vā te dussīle vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:3.8: “Jānāmahaṃ, bhante, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme; ye ca loke dussīlā pāpadhammā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā tesaṃ aññatarā”ti.
segments.sn42.13:3.10: ‘pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi jānāti koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme, pāṭaliyopi gāmaṇi dussīlo pāpadhammo’ti, sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:3.12: Aññe, bhante, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā, aññohamasmi. Aññathādhammā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā, aññathādhammohamasmī”ti.
segments.sn42.13:3.13: “Tvañhi nāma, gāmaṇi, lacchasi – ‘pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi jānāti koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme, na ca pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi dussīlo pāpadhammo’ti, kasmā tathāgato na lacchati – ‘tathāgato māyaṃ jānāti, na ca tathāgato māyāvī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:3.14: Māyaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, māyāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca māyāvī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi”.
segments.sn42.13:4.1: “Pāṇātipātaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, pāṇātipātassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca pāṇātipātī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.2: Adinnādānaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, adinnādānassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca adinnādāyī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.3: Kāmesumicchācāraṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, kāmesumicchācārassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca kāmesumicchācārī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.4: Musāvādaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, musāvādassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca musāvādī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.5: Pisuṇavācaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, pisuṇavācāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca pisuṇavāco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.6: Pharusavācaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, pharusavācāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca pharusavāco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.7: Samphappalāpaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, samphappalāpassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca samphappalāpī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.8: Abhijjhaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, abhijjhāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca abhijjhālu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.9: Byāpādapadosaṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, byāpādapadosassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca byāpannacitto kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:4.10: Micchādiṭṭhiṃ cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhiyā ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca micchādiṭṭhiko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
segments.sn42.13:5.1: “Santi hi, gāmaṇi, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino –
segments.sn42.13:5.2: ‘yo koci pāṇamatipāteti, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
segments.sn42.13:5.3: Yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
segments.sn42.13:5.4: Yo koci kāmesu micchā carati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
segments.sn42.13:5.5: Yo koci musā bhaṇati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:6.1: “Dissati kho pana, gāmaṇi, idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto [sunahāto (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricārento.
segments.sn42.13:6.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:6.5: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso rañño paccatthikaṃ pasayha jīvitā voropesi.
segments.sn42.13:6.7: Tenāyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu, itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:7.1: “Dissati kho, gāmaṇi, idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ [rathikāya rathikaṃ (sī.)] siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā, dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā, dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno.
segments.sn42.13:7.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi, daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindatī’ti [chijjatīti (katthaci)]?
segments.sn42.13:7.5: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso rājaverī itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā jīvitā voropesi,
segments.sn42.13:7.6: tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakāraṇaṃ kārentī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:8.2: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:8.4: “Tatra, gāmaṇi, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino –
segments.sn42.13:8.5: ‘yo koci pāṇamatipāteti, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatī’ti, saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:8.7: “Ye pana te tucchaṃ musā vilapanti, sīlavanto vā te dussīlā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:8.9: “Ye pana te dussīlā pāpadhammā micchāpaṭipannā vā te sammāpaṭipannā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:8.11: “Ye pana te micchāpaṭipannā micchādiṭṭhikā vā te sammādiṭṭhikā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:8.13: “Ye pana te micchādiṭṭhikā kallaṃ nu tesu pasīditun”ti?
segments.sn42.13:9.1: “Dissati kho pana, gāmaṇi, idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī … pe … itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricārento.
segments.sn42.13:9.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī … pe … itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:9.5: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso rañño paccatthikassa pasayha ratanaṃ ahāsi [pasayha adinnaṃ ratanaṃ ādiyi (ka.)].
segments.sn42.13:9.7: Tenāyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī … pe … itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:10.1: “Dissati kho, gāmaṇi, idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā … pe … dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno tamenaṃ evamāhaṃsu –
segments.sn42.13:10.2: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi daḷhāya rajjuyā … pe … dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindatī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:10.4: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi.
segments.sn42.13:10.5: Tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakāraṇaṃ kārentī’ti.
segments.sn42.13:10.7: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:10.9: “Tatra, gāmaṇi, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino –
segments.sn42.13:10.10: ‘yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatī’ti, saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vāti … pe …
segments.sn42.13:11.1: “Dissati kho pana, gāmaṇi, idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī … pe … itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricārento.
segments.sn42.13:11.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī … pe … itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:11.5: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso rañño paccatthikassa dāresu cārittaṃ āpajji.
segments.sn42.13:11.7: Tenāyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī … pe … itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:12.1: “Dissati kho, gāmaṇi, idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā … pe … dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno.
segments.sn42.13:12.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi daḷhāya rajjuyā … pe … dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindatī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:12.5: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kulitthīsu kulakumārīsu cārittaṃ āpajji,
segments.sn42.13:12.6: tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakāraṇaṃ kārentī’ti.
segments.sn42.13:12.8: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:12.10: “Tatra, gāmaṇi, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino –
segments.sn42.13:12.11: ‘yo koci kāmesu micchā carati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatī’ti, saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vāti … pe …
segments.sn42.13:13.1: “Dissati kho pana, gāmaṇi, idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricārento.
segments.sn42.13:13.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:13.7: Tenāyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:14.1: “Dissati kho, gāmaṇi, idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno.
segments.sn42.13:14.3: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā, dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā, dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindatī’ti?
segments.sn42.13:14.5: ‘ambho! Ayaṃ puriso gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā musāvādena atthaṃ bhañji,
segments.sn42.13:14.6: tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakāraṇaṃ kārentī’ti.
segments.sn42.13:14.8: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:14.10: “Tatra, gāmaṇi, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino –
segments.sn42.13:14.11: ‘yo koci musā bhaṇati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatī’ti, saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:14.13: “Ye pana te tucchaṃ musā vilapanti sīlavanto vā te dussīlā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:14.15: “Ye pana te dussīlā pāpadhammā micchāpaṭipannā vā te sammāpaṭipannā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:14.17: “Ye pana te micchāpaṭipannā micchādiṭṭhikā vā te sammādiṭṭhikā vā”ti?
segments.sn42.13:14.19: “Ye pana te micchādiṭṭhikā kallaṃ nu tesu pasīditun”ti?
segments.sn42.13:15.3: Tattha atthi mañcakāni, atthi āsanāni, atthi udakamaṇiko, atthi telappadīpo.
segments.sn42.13:15.4: Tattha yo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vāsaṃ upeti, tenāhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmi.
segments.sn42.13:15.5: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, cattāro satthāro nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā, tasmiṃ āvasathāgāre vāsaṃ upagacchuṃ”.
segments.sn42.13:16.2: ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko. Natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:17.2: ‘atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:18.2: ‘karoto kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato, socayato socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato, pāṇamatipātayato, adinnaṃ ādiyato, sandhiṃ chindato, nillopaṃ harato, ekāgārikaṃ karoto, paripanthe tiṭṭhato, paradāraṃ gacchato, musā bhaṇato, karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.
segments.sn42.13:18.3: Khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
segments.sn42.13:18.4: Dakkhiṇaṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācāpento, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
segments.sn42.13:18.5: Uttaraṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yajāpento, natthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo.
segments.sn42.13:18.6: Dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo’”ti.
segments.sn42.13:19.2: ‘karoto kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato, socayato socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato, pāṇamatipātayato, adinnaṃ ādiyato, sandhiṃ chindato, nillopaṃ harato, ekāgārikaṃ karoto, paripanthe tiṭṭhato, paradāraṃ gacchato, musā bhaṇato, karoto karīyati pāpaṃ.
segments.sn42.13:19.3: Khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, atthi pāpassa āgamo.
segments.sn42.13:19.4: Dakkhiṇaṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācāpento, atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, atthi pāpassa āgamo. Uttaraṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento, yajanto yajāpento, atthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo. Dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena atthi puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo’”ti. “Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, ahudeva kaṅkhā, ahu vicikicchā – ‘kosu nāma imesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ āha, ko musā’”ti? “Alañhi te, gāmaṇi, kaṅkhituṃ, alaṃ vicikicchituṃ. Kaṅkhanīye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā”ti. “Evaṃ pasannohaṃ, bhante, bhagavati. Pahoti me bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyan”ti. “Atthi, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi. Tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi. Evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi. Katamo ca, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi? Idha, gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, abhijjhaṃ pahāya anabhijjhālu hoti, byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto hoti, micchādiṭṭhiṃ pahāya sammādiṭṭhiko hoti. “Sa kho so, gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘yvāyaṃ satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā, sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti. ‘Sace tassa bhoto satthuno saccaṃ vacanaṃ, apaṇṇakatāya mayhaṃ, yvāhaṃ [yohaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] na kiñci [kañci (?)] byābādhemi tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā? Ubhayamettha [ubhayattha me (?) ma. ni.2.95 pāḷiyā saṃsandetabbaṃ] kaṭaggāho, yaṃ camhi kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto, yañca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī’ti [paraṃ maraṇā na upapajjissāmīti (?)]. Tassa pāmojjaṃ jāyati. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati. Pītimanassa kāyo passambhati. Passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati. Sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ kho, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi. Tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi, evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi. “Sa kho so, gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘yvāyaṃ satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā, sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti. ‘Sace tassa bhoto satthuno saccaṃ vacanaṃ, apaṇṇakatāya mayhaṃ, yvāhaṃ na kiñci byābādhemi tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā? Ubhayamettha kaṭaggāho, yaṃ camhi kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto, yañca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī’ti. Tassa pāmojjaṃ jāyati. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati. Pītimanassa kāyo passambhati. Passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedayati. Sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ kho, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi. Tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi, evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi. “Sa kho so, gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘yvāyaṃ satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – karoto kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato, socayato socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato, pāṇamatipātayato, adinnaṃ ādiyato, sandhiṃ chindato, nillopaṃ harato, ekāgārikaṃ karoto, paripanthe tiṭṭhato, paradāraṃ gacchato, musā bhaṇato, karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ. Khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo. Dakkhiṇañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācāpento, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.

segments.sn42.13:25.8: Dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo’ti.

lines: Terasame dūteyyānīti dūtakammāni paṇṇāni ceva mukhasāsanāni ca.
Na kevalaṃ ahaṃ māyaṃ jānāmi, aññampi idañcidañca jānāmīti sabbaññubhāvadassanatthaṃ āraddhaṃ.
Santi hi, gāmaṇi, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇāti idaṃ sesasamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ laddhiṃ dassetvā tassā pajahāpanatthaṃ āraddhaṃ.
Itthikāmehīti itthīhi saddhiṃ kāmā itthikāmā, tehi itthikāmehi.
Āvasathāgāranti kulagharassa ekasmiṃ ṭhāne ekekasseva sukhanivāsatthāya kataṃ vāsāgāraṃ.
Tenāhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmīti tassāhaṃ attano sattianurūpena ceva balānurūpena ca saṃvibhāgaṃ karomi.
Cittasamādhinti tasmiṃ dhammasamādhismiṃ ṭhito tvaṃ saha vipassanāya catunnaṃ maggānaṃ vasena cittasamādhiṃ sace paṭilabheyyāsīti dasseti.
Apaṇṇakatāya mayhanti ayaṃ paṭipadā mayhaṃ apaṇṇakatāya anaparādhakatāya eva saṃvattatīti attho.
Ayaṃ kho, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi, tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsīti ettha dhammasamādhīti dasakusalakammapathadhammā, cittasamādhīti saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā.

Atha vā “pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī”ti (a. ni.5.26) evaṃ vuttā pāmojjapītipassaddhisukhasamādhisaṅkhātā pañca dhammā dhammasamādhi nāma, cittasamādhi pana saha vipassanāya cattāro maggāva.
Atha vā dasakusalakammapathā cattāro brahmavihārā cāti ayaṃ dhammasamādhi nāma, taṃ dhammasamādhiṃ pūrentassa uppannā cittekaggatā cittasamādhi nāma.
Evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsīti evaṃ tvaṃ imasmiṃ vuttappabhede dhammasamādhismiṃ ṭhito sace evaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi, ekaṃsenetaṃ kaṅkhaṃ pajaheyyāsīti attho.
“ko cādi kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, sīlañca suvisuddhaṃ diṭṭhi ca ujukā”ti (saṃ. ni.5.369).
Tattha patiṭṭhitassa upari kattabbaṃ dassetuṃ “dhammasamādhismiṃ ṭhito”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Ayaṃ paṭipadāti tassa kammaphalavādino satthu vacanaṃ sabbesañca ayaṃ mayhaṃ sīlasaṃvarabrahmavihārabhāvanāsaṅkhātāpaṭipadā anaparādhakatāya eva saṃvattati.
Tatiyavikappe sīlādivisuddhiyā saddhiṃ brahmavihārā yathāvuttatividhadhammāvahattā eva dhammasamādhi nāma.
Sāpi cittassa samādhānato “cittasamādhī”ti vuttā, tassa paṭipakkhaṃ vikkhambhantī samucchindantī ca hutvā pavattā yathāvuttasamādhi eva visesena cittasamādhi nāma.

“Māyañcāhaṃ pajānāmī”ti vacanaṃ kāmaṃ tesaṃ māyāvībhāvadassanaparaṃ, bhagavato pana māyāsāṭheyyādikassa sabbassa pāpadhammassa bodhimūle eva setughāto, tasmā sabbaso pahīnamāyo, sabbaññutāya māyaṃ aññe ca ñeyye sabbaso jānāti.
Māyañca pajānāmīti na kevalamahaṃ māyaṃ eva jānāmi, atha kho aññampi idañcidañca jānāmīti.
